text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Summer Training Camp season had 
arrived once again. Her Japan Cup rival, 
El Condor Pasa, was in terrifyingly 
phenomenal shape.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa's fighting spirit ignited 
as well. The battle heading into the Japan 
Cup had already begun.
